verdict.rationale: Stripe documents API equivalents for the main Dashboard workflows: refunds via the Refunds API or the Dashboard, programmatic dispute evidence and responses, Checkout Sessions, Billing, payouts, Connect and webhooks. The hosted MCP server exposes generic read/write tools for any Stripe API method, and Workbench Shell and the CLI mirror Dashboard actions, with a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients. Several administrative tasks are only evidenced as Dashboard actions, including creating restricted keys, managing MCP access, approving agent write confirmations and tracking payouts. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity, evidence that account-administration settings (key creation, MCP access governance) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
